description: PostgreSQL 18 name clipping and internal char byte semantics
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_name_internal_char (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, catalog_name NAME UNIQUE, kind "char");

SELECT id, length(catalog_name::text) AS char_length, octet_length(catalog_name::text) AS byte_length, kind::text AS kind_text, kind::int4 AS kind_code FROM type_matrix_name_internal_char ORDER BY type_matrix_name_internal_char.kind;
